content: the device's property schema: every object's type, property types, real-unit ranges and enumerations. NOT its current settings.
keyed_by: paths maps an object path to a meta hash; metas maps that hash to the meta itself; rosters is keyed by object path then property name

x-options.subtext: On Press results in some footswitch functionality becoming disabled via hold.

notes: PROPERTY VALUES ARE NOT IN THIS FILE, except the allowlist below. The subtree response carries the owner's live rig state beside the schema, and that is personal preset data AGENTS.md says not to commit. On the capture this file was built from, the tree held rig names, rig ids and setlist names under /Evil/API/Rigs and /Evil/API/Setlists; none of it is here, because the default is to drop.

allowlisted values, each device capability rather than owner state: /Evil/API/Blocks.BlockSelectorCategories (the block category vocabulary); /Evil/API/Blocks.BlockSelectorCategoriesForDisplay (the same categories as shown on the unit); /Evil/API/Blocks.ModuleTypes (the block roster ModuleType{n} indexes into); /Evil/Gui.AppVersion (the firmware every other fact here is true of)

metas are stored once per DISTINCT meta, keyed by a 16 hex char sha256 of the canonical JSON, with paths mapping to them. A hash that already holds a different meta is refused, so the dedup is lossless by check and not by assertion.

measured on fw 5.1.0.2a63755: 309 objects reduce to 161 distinct metas, and 10 of the 122 sharing groups are NOT base/base_2 pairs, the largest being ['/Evil/Engine/Patch/Green_JRC-OD', '/Evil/Engine/Patch/Green_JRC-OD_2', '/Evil/Engine/Patch/Greener', '/Evil/Engine/Patch/Greener_2', '/Evil/Engine/Patch/K_Drive', '/Evil/Engine/Patch/K_Drive_2', '/Evil/Engine/Patch/S1_Drive', '/Evil/Engine/Patch/S1_Drive_2', '/Evil/Engine/Patch/Slab_O_Meat', '/Evil/Engine/Patch/Slab_O_Meat_2']. Different models, identical parameter surfaces, so a parameter set is not an identity for a model and a consumer must not treat it as one.
measured on fw 5.1.0.2a63755: Chain.ModuleType{n} is an integer 0..277 with no names of its own; the names are the ModuleTypes roster, whose 278 entries begin with 'Empty Slot'.

this API does NOT mark twins. Issue #109 says the _2 objects carry twin: true; no meta in this file has any such field. The strings containing 'twin' in the metas of this capture are 'California Twin 212 Combo', which are model names. Separately, and NOT checked by this script: /api/v1/object-meta was compared against /api/v1/subtree by hand on fw 5.1.0.2a63755 and returned byte-identical meta for the same path.
source: the unit's own self-description, GET /api/v1/subtree/ over HTTP on port 80, fetched by tools/build_headrush_schema.py through devices/headrush/client.py. Generated, never hand edited.
support_status: measured on a HeadRush Core at this firmware only. Prime and Flex Prime are one engine per the spec and are UNTESTED, not assumed (#33).
warning: one firmware, one chassis. Re-generate rather than edit; the file is deterministic, so a re-run on the same firmware is a no-op diff and a re-run on new firmware is a readable one.
